description: The bar chart compares the performance of three models—RedWhale (our), Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis represents performance scores, with values ranging from 0.42 to 1.00, and the horizontal axis lists the evaluation categories. For each category, three bars are displayed: a dark purple bar for RedWhale (our), a light blue bar for Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and a light gray bar for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). In all categories, the SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model achieves a score of 1.00, serving as the baseline. RedWhale (our) consistently outperforms Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 across all categories, with scores of 0.42 (PT-EVAL), 0.52 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.71 (KoBEST-CP), 0.50 (KoBEST-HS), 0.69 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.57 (AVG). Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 achieves scores of 0.46 (PT-EVAL), 0.56 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.74 (KoBEST-CP), 0.54 (KoBEST-HS), 0.73 (KoBEST-SN), and 0.61 (AVG). The average performance (AVG) shows RedWhale at 0.57 and Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 at 0.61, indicating that while RedWhale performs better in most individual tasks, Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 has a slightly higher average score. The chart visually emphasizes the relative performance of the models, with the light gray bars consistently at the top, indicating the baseline model's superior performance in this evaluation framework.
